name: Debtor exports are masked for non-staff roles and logged
title: SC-11-02-02 Debtor exports are masked for non-staff roles and logged
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a debtor list containing personal data
When a non-staff role exports the debtors
Then names are masked and every export is logged
